summary: Editing sales order lines in a spreadsheet inside Business Central with the Advanced Spreadsheets and Reporting app. The demo uses the "Open lines in spreadsheet" action, where a green spreadsheet region stays connected to the sales order and edits update it directly.
overview:
Erik Hougaard shows how to open the lines of a sales order in a spreadsheet from the Actions menu. The spreadsheet has a green region connected directly to the sales order, so work done in the spreadsheet is written to the order behind the scenes.

He shows that calculations and totals update as line items are edited. He suggests this for complicated cases such as configurations or customer-driven changes. The app requires installation, and links for installing it in a cloud sandbox are given in the video description.
key_points: Open a sales order, go to Actions and choose "Open lines in spreadsheet".
The feature requires the Advanced Spreadsheets and Reporting app.
The green region in the spreadsheet is connected directly to the sales order.
Edits made in the spreadsheet are updated directly on the sales order behind the scene.
Calculations and totals update as line items are edited.
Suggested uses: working with configurations and other complicated sales order scenarios.
The app can be installed in a cloud sandbox to try for free, with links in the video description.
